conditions: Search for 'Pliers' (a word that appears in multiple product names)
items.expected: Only products whose names contain 'Pliers' are shown (e.g. 'Combination Pliers', 'Pliers', 'Long Nose Pliers'); products not containing 'Pliers' are not shown

conditions: Search for 'xyznonexistent' (a word no product name contains)
items.expected: A 'no products found' message is displayed and no product cards are shown

conditions: Search for 'Pliers' to filter the list; then clear the search field and submit (or click X)
items.expected: The search field is empty (showing the clear action took effect); the full product list is restored and a product not in the filtered set (e.g. 'Bolt Cutters') is visible again

conditions: Navigate to home page with search panel visible; run axe-core scan scoped to the search form, checking WCAG A and AA rules
items.expected: No accessibility violations reported for the search area (violations.map(v=>v.id).sort() equals [])

excluded.reason: TOOL-21 concerns the Admin interface product search, not the shopper-facing search this story covers; it does not touch AC-1, AC-2, or AC-3
TOOL-20 concerns the billing address step in checkout, which is entirely unrelated to product search
